links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of LLM responses to patient-level menopause questions
links.effect: FRES differed significantly (P<0.001): Gemini 38.9±7.3 (difficult), ChatGPT 3.5 31.0±11.2 and ChatGPT 4.0 26.5±8.6 (both very difficult).
links.quote: FRES scores differed significantly ( P <0.001): Gemini scored 38.9±7.3 ("difficult"), ChatGPT 3.5 scored 31.0±11.2, and ChatGPT 4.0 scored 26.5±8.6 (both "very difficult").

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of LLM answers to menopause and hormone therapy questions
links.effect: Patient-level accuracy: ChatGPT 3.5 70%, ChatGPT 4.0 60%, Gemini 30%. Clinician-level: ChatGPT 4.0 67%, ChatGPT 3.5 and OpenEvidence 60%, Gemini 47%.
links.quote: LLMs demonstrated limited accuracy and frequent incorrect or incomplete responses to menopause-related queries, highlighting the need to improve model performance to ensure accurate and reliable information for both patients and clinicians.

screen.reason: Evaluates accuracy, completeness, and readability of four LLMs answering menopause and hormone therapy questions using expert scoring and readability formulas without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
